title: OCR routing evaluation
finding: `improve-rag-input-quality-5` task 5.1. Run 1 FAILED on the structure-marker gate — the original fixtures were 605-byte blank PDFs with nothing to OCR (commit `a7d7cd2`, honest negative). Task 1.1 repair replaced them with rasterised pages from a CC0 paper (Dashnow et al. 2014, attribution + sha256 in the fixtures manifest, commit `786055e`); gates unchanged. Run 2: all five gates PASS — 0 failures, 3/3 fast-path byte-identity, worker 156.9 s/page ≤ 180 (13% margin), routing 2.26 ms ≤ 50, headings recovered on both routed pages, ground-truth word recall 93.1%/94.3%. Full worker Markdown committed in `output/ablation.json`
